narration: Amazon fought 20 years to protect one button. Every checkout step they remove makes you spend 12 percent more. Here's where your $1,300 goes.
visual: Dark background. Large amber BUY NOW button springs in from below with three gold coins arcing outward. Counter animates to 12%. Text overlay: THE $1,300 BUTTON. Amber accent theme.

narration: Researchers proved adding just one extra confirmation screen cuts impulse buying by 15 percent. So apps bury the cancel option in tiny gray text on purpose.
visual: Light background. Three checkout step rectangles stack up, then two get crossed out with red X marks. Arrow points down to a single amber BUY NOW button. Bar chart grows showing spending increase as steps disappear.

narration: Your confirm button is huge and bright amber. Your cancel button is tiny and gray. That single design decision boosts checkout rates by 35 percent.
visual: Dark background. Giant amber CONFIRM ORDER button scales in from center. Small gray cancel text fades in below. Labels show size contrast. Stat: 35% MORE CHECKOUTS. Not an accident label.

narration: Netflix built a five-step cancellation maze for a reason. Apps that make it hard to cancel keep 68 percent of users paying three extra months they never intended.
visual: Light background. Three app icons (circle badges with letters N, A, D) spring in. Padlock overlays appear on each. Counter animates to 68%. Three amber calendar squares show M1, M2, M3 — unintended months billed.

narration: The average American makes 246 impulse digital purchases a year. At 12 percent overspend per order, that's $1,300 flowing out of your wallet by design.
visual: Dark background. Person silhouette (circle head, rectangle body) on left with wallet shape draining coins. Purchase counter animates to 246 then dollar counter grows to $1,300. Equation displayed: 246 × 12% = $1,300.

narration: Here's the fix — add friction back yourself. Delete saved payment info from apps and use a 24-hour wish list rule. One small habit, $1,300 back in your pocket.
visual: Light background. Person silhouette holding shield blocking a phone/device. Two checklist items appear: DELETE SAVED PAYMENT INFO and 24-HOUR WISH LIST RULE with amber checkmarks. $1,300 SAVED badge springs in. Follow CTA.
